opening_condition: One Study C identity-opening authorization may be issued only after slot C is programmatically authorized, all required historical/current environmental assets are frozen and admissible, confirmatory masks pass, and exact survivor geometry reruns the frozen C qualification at alpha=0.025 with every gate passing.

genetic_response.marker: mitochondrial COI/COX1 family under the inherited exact alias parser
genetic_response.panel_selection: response-blind one-panel-per-species: most exact unique localities, then more aligned headers, then lexicographic locus identifier
genetic_response.sequence_pair_distance: uncorrected p-distance over jointly canonical columns
genetic_response.locality_pair_distance: arithmetic mean over every valid cross-locality sequence-pair p-distance
genetic_response.edge_response: locality-pair p-distance on the unchanged density-scaled kNN edge
genetic_response.source_training_response: post-IBD turnover rank orthogonalized against within-source edge-length rank
genetic_response.source_to_target_score: T_st = Spearman correlation between source-only TTF field prediction and target post-IBD turnover

relational_model.covariance: two-way source/target cluster-robust sandwich with dyad intersection subtraction and finite-cluster corrections

program_transition.preopening_gate_failure: close under the appropriate partial/no-evaluable state; no replacement slot
program_transition.postopening_execution_failure: freeze technical failure receipt; no result-selection rerun or alternate historical predictor

one_shot_rules: Do not alter species, dyads, historical/current relation definitions, controls, climate assets, genetic response, IBD, kernel, covariance, alpha or decision rule after identity opening.
Do not test an alternate time slice, paleoclimate product, refugium, ice-sheet, barrier, threshold, subgroup or interaction as replacement primary analysis.
After Study C the v0.3 ecological-predictor program closes permanently.
